messages:
maya: quick check — for the new internal inference API, are we leaning grpc-first or rest-first? thinking about console UX, routing policies, quotas.
sam: grpc-first from a perf/throughput POV. but browser -> grpc-web adds gateway complexity and more moving parts.
jordan: yup. rest is easiest for web clients. grpc-web needs a translation layer which can duplicate quota/telemetry logic.
lee: telemetry note — our current metrics pipeline expects http attributes (method, path). grpc methods map differently; we'd need to add method->route labels.
emily: proposal: proto-first design. expose grpc internally, but offer a REST bridge at the gateway for console/SDKs. gateway owns auth/quota translation.
maya: ok — gateway owning quota is ok but we need dedupe guarantees (no double-counting) and consistent request ids for billing.
sam: gateway can attach x-rdw-request-id and forward. control plane can dedupe by that id when counting tokens.
jordan: another worry: if gateway modifies requests for routing (model variant rewrite), logs must show original+effective route for rollouts UX.
lee: agree. telemetry should include fields: original_route, effective_route, model_variant, routing_reason. otherwise dashboards will be confusing.
emily: for rollout UX we want canary flags and percentage-based routing. prefer a proto spec for evaluation so we can simulate in the console.
maya: what about streaming? long responses for generation — grpc bidi streaming is ideal. gateway translation introduces chunking complexity.
sam: true. gateway can pass through streams for grpc-web (via envoy) but there might be latency overhead. advanced users could call grpc directly to avoid it.
jordan: cost accounting question: if gateway retries or mirrors traffic for fallback, who gets billed? need explicit billing policy in RFC.
lee: metric spike prevention: when we do rollouts, we should tag metrics so infra can apply rate limits per variant.
emily: small proto snippet for discussion:

```proto
service Inference {
  rpc StreamGenerate(stream GenerateRequest) returns (stream GenerateResponse);
}

message GenerateRequest { string prompt = 1; map<string,string> meta = 2; }
message GenerateResponse { string chunk = 1; }
```

sam: and a simple envoy translation example (gateway will need to map grpc method to /v1/generate POST):

```yaml
- match: { path: "/v1/generate", method: POST }
  route: { cluster: inference-grpc }
  transform: grpc-bridge
```

maya: action items from this thread:
1) draft RFC (proto-first, gateway as translation + quota enforcer, billing policy) — owner: jordan
2) infra spike: grpc-web gateway + streaming perf tests — owner: sam
3) metrics schema update + telemetry fields — owner: lee
4) devex wrapper + console UX for canary toggles — owner: emily
5) rollout runbook & billing clarifications — owner: ops (will coordinate)

jordan: I'll start the RFC today, will include sample traffic matrices and billing scenarios.
sam: starting spike tomorrow, will post perf numbers in #eng-platform once I have results.
lee: will add required labels to metrics schema PR and forward to observability.
emily: I'll draft console mockups for how to show original vs effective route and variant counts.
ops-bot: Jira created: RDW-5123 (RFC), RDW-5124 (gateway-spike), RDW-5125 (metrics-update), RDW-5126 (devex-ux).
maya: thanks all — let's sync next week after initial PRs. :thumbsup:
